sources.title: Archontology — Henri-Philippe-Bénoni-Omer-Joseph Pétain
sources.citation_text: Individual office chronology: minister of war 9 Feb–8 Nov 1934, 1–4 June 1935 minister of state, deputy PM 18 May–16 June, PM from 16 June 1940 until 18 April 1942, de facto state head 11 Jul 1940–20 Aug 1944.

sources.title: French National Assembly — 10 July 1940 constitutional vote
sources.citation_text: Assembly documents Pétain succeeding Reynaud as president of council on 16 June, July 10 full constitutional powers vote and July 11 implementation distinct.

sources.title: Légifrance — Ordinance 9 August 1944 Article 7
sources.citation_text: Defines Vichy as de facto authority, not legally continuous Republic; Article 1 asserts juridical continuity of French Republic.
